# The Learning Hypothesis

> A STEM education platform offering interactive biology curriculum, escape room DIY kits, and comprehensive teaching resources for educators and homeschoolers.

The Learning Hypothesis, founded by Kim, provides science education resources including the Biology Resource Hub membership with guided notes and presentations, lesson planning tools, and innovative classroom engagement strategies. The platform serves teachers and homeschool educators through multiple content channels and product offerings.

## Key Topics

- Biology teaching
- STEM education
- Escape room DIY kits
- Lesson planning
- Teacher resources
- Homeschool curriculum
- Anatomy
- Photosynthesis
- Cellular respiration
- Educational games
- Science education
- Interactive learning
- Professional development
- Guided notes
- Biology Resource Hub

- [The Learning Hypothesis](https://learninghypothesis.com): Homepage for The Learning Hypothesis, Kim's STEM education platform

## Products & Resources

- [Biology Resource Hub Membership](https://club.learninghypothesis.com/brhsales-bdqTOP): Biology Resource HUB membership with curriculum, guided notes, and presentations
- [Shop](https://learninghypothesis.com/shop): Shop for e-books, teaching resources, and educational products across science subjects
- [Create Your Own Escape Rooms](https://learninghypothesis.com/create-your-own-escape-rooms): Guide to creating DIY escape rooms for classroom engagement and interactive learning
